attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Nevada Commerce Tax return. Checks for physical presence, economic nexus, and revenue threshold.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in Nevada; has_physical_presence == true AND below threshold
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.has_physical_presence_nv { pop nv_result.gross_revenue nv_result.commerce_tax_threshold f< } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence and exceeds threshold; has_physical_presence == true AND exceeds threshold
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.has_physical_presence_nv { pop nv_result.gross_revenue nv_result.commerce_tax_threshold f>= } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Has economic nexus and exceeds threshold; has_economic_nexus == true AND exceeds threshold
condition_details.condition_postfix: nv_result.gross_revenue result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold f>= { pop nv_result.gross_revenue nv_result.commerce_tax_threshold f>= } over if

action_details.action_comment: Physical presence but below threshold - no Commerce Tax due
action_details.action_dsl: set nv_result.qualifies_for_exemption = true; set nv_result.commerce_tax = 0.0; set result.state_tax = 0.0;
action_details.action_postfix: true cvb /nv_result.qualifies_for_exemption xdef 0.0 cvd /nv_result.commerce_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /result.state_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus and above threshold - Commerce Tax required
Economic nexus and above threshold - Commerce Tax required

action_details.action_dsl: set nv_result.qualifies_for_exemption = true; set nv_result.commerce_tax = 0.0; set result.state_tax = 0.0; set result.state_refund_or_owed = result.state_payments;
action_details.action_postfix: true cvb /nv_result.qualifies_for_exemption xdef 0.0 cvd /nv_result.commerce_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /result.state_tax xdef result.state_payments cvd /result.state_refund_or_owed xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Nevada has NO corporate income tax. This table confirms zero income tax liability for consistency with framework.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus with Nevada; has_economic_nexus == true OR has_physical_presence == true
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.has_physical_presence_nv { pop nv_result.gross_revenue result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold f>= } over not if

action_details.action_comment: Nevada has NO corporate income tax
action_details.action_dsl: set result.state_tax_rate = 0.0; set result.state_additions = 0.0; set result.state_subtractions = 0.0;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.state_tax_rate xdef 0.0 cvd /result.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /result.state_subtractions xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.state_tax_rate = 0.0; set result.state_additions = 0.0; set result.state_subtractions = 0.0;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.state_tax_rate xdef 0.0 cvd /result.state_additions xdef 0.0 cvd /result.state_subtractions xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine Nevada business classification for Commerce Tax rate. Sets appropriate Commerce Tax rate based on industry (NAICS code).
Calculate Nevada-sitused gross revenue for Commerce Tax. Uses market-based sourcing to determine revenue attributable to Nevada.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and has apportionment percentage
condition_details.condition_postfix: has_nexus { pop apportionment_percentage 0 f> } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus but no apportionment percentage
condition_details.condition_postfix: has_nexus { pop apportionment_percentage 0 f== } over if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Nevada-sitused revenue using market-based sourcing
action_details.action_dsl: set nv_result.sitused_revenue = result.total_revenue * result.apportionment_percentage; set nv_result.gross_revenue = nv_result.sitused_revenue;
action_details.action_postfix: result.total_revenue result.apportionment_percentage fmul cvd /nv_result.sitused_revenue xdef nv_result.sitused_revenue cvd /nv_result.gross_revenue xdef

action_details.action_comment: No apportionment - assume 100% Nevada if nexus exists
action_details.action_dsl: set nv_result.sitused_revenue = result.total_revenue; set nv_result.gross_revenue = result.total_revenue;
action_details.action_postfix: result.total_revenue cvd /nv_result.sitused_revenue xdef result.total_revenue cvd /nv_result.gross_revenue xdef

action_details.action_comment: No Nevada nexus - no revenue sitused to Nevada

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Nevada Commerce Tax liability. Applies Commerce Tax rate to Nevada-sitused gross revenue exceeding $4M. IMPORTANT: This is a gross receipts tax, NOT an income tax.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and exceeds $4M threshold; has_nexus AND gross_revenue >= threshold
condition_details.condition_dsl: (result.has_physical_presence_nv or nv_result.gross_revenue >= result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold) and nv_result.gross_revenue >= nv_result.commerce_tax_threshold
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.has_physical_presence_nv { pop nv_result.gross_revenue result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold f>= } over not if { pop nv_result.gross_revenue nv_result.commerce_tax_threshold f>= } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus but below threshold; has_nexus AND gross_revenue < threshold
condition_details.condition_dsl: (result.has_physical_presence_nv or nv_result.gross_revenue >= result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold) and nv_result.gross_revenue < nv_result.commerce_tax_threshold
condition_details.condition_postfix: result.has_physical_presence_nv { pop nv_result.gross_revenue result.nv_economic_nexus_threshold f>= } over not if { pop nv_result.gross_revenue nv_result.commerce_tax_threshold f< } over if

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Commerce Tax on taxable revenue
action_details.action_dsl: set nv_result.taxable_revenue = the maximum of (nv_result.gross_revenue - nv_result.commerce_tax_threshold) and (0.0); set nv_result.commerce_tax = nv_result.taxable_revenue * nv_result.commerce_tax_rate; set nv_result.commerce_tax = the maximum of (nv_result.commerce_tax - result.state_credits) and (0.0); set result.state_tax = nv_result.commerce_tax; set result.state_refund_or_owed = result.state_payments - result.state_tax;
action_details.action_postfix: nv_result.gross_revenue nv_result.commerce_tax_threshold f- 0.0 fmax cvd /nv_result.taxable_revenue xdef nv_result.taxable_revenue nv_result.commerce_tax_rate fmul cvd /nv_result.commerce_tax xdef nv_result.commerce_tax result.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /nv_result.commerce_tax xdef nv_result.commerce_tax cvd /result.state_tax xdef result.state_payments result.state_tax f- cvd /result.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set nv_result.qualifies_for_exemption = true; set nv_result.taxable_revenue = 0.0; set nv_result.commerce_tax = 0.0; set result.state_tax = 0.0; set result.state_refund_or_owed = result.state_payments;
action_details.action_postfix: true cvb /nv_result.qualifies_for_exemption xdef 0.0 cvd /nv_result.taxable_revenue xdef 0.0 cvd /nv_result.commerce_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /result.state_tax xdef result.state_payments cvd /result.state_refund_or_owed xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set nv_result.qualifies_for_exemption = true; set nv_result.taxable_revenue = 0.0; set nv_result.commerce_tax = 0.0; set result.state_tax = 0.0; set result.state_refund_or_owed = result.state_payments;
action_details.action_postfix: true cvb /nv_result.qualifies_for_exemption xdef 0.0 cvd /nv_result.taxable_revenue xdef 0.0 cvd /nv_result.commerce_tax xdef 0.0 cvd /result.state_tax xdef result.state_payments cvd /result.state_refund_or_owed xdef
